name: aspen-code
description: Customize an Aspen instance with the aspen CLI. Two gates before the first file: lean-data-model asks whether a component should exist at all, model-first places it in the right tier. using-aspen is the loop after — copy a compiled shape, author into metadata/, validate offline, compile, deploy, verify. Plus a server skeleton, trigger patterns, and guards that ask before duplicating an object or adding a custom UI surface.
